info.name: UntrashOS
info.summary: Nextcloud as a member of UntrashMesh: address directory and change feed of UntrashOS NAS
info.description:
This Nextcloud joins an UntrashMesh (the encrypted network of UntrashOS devices).
* **Directory:** members keep their signed address records here, at the stable internet address of this Nextcloud, and find each other again after their addresses changed. * **Change feed:** a linked UntrashOS NAS tells this Nextcloud which files changed in its shares. External storages (WebDAV) on that NAS are updated path by path instead of being scanned, so the NAS disks can sleep.
Contract: docs/architecture/cloud-api.md in the UntrashOS repository.
